overview: The Throne of Aten Ha Ra is the holiest and most dangerous chamber in Vex Thal.
details: Aten Ha Ra’s divine resonance permeates the chamber. Voidstone pillars channel her power, while temporal sanctums stabilize her presence across fractured timelines.
hooks: Aten Ha Ra’s avatar manifests within the throne hall.
Voidstone pillars destabilize, threatening a divine resonance collapse.
Temporal sanctums flicker, revealing ancient Akhevan visions.
Xi Thall commanders gather for a divine rite.
